# TerrainMoss

`terrain_material`

Mossy forest floor under the twilight canopy.

> Give the twilight grove its own ground

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| layer | integer | Index of this material in the terrain shader's texture arrays and its weight channel in CUSTOM0/CUSTOM1 (Phase 242) |
| textureKey | string | Asset key prefix; the maps are <key>_albedo/_normal/_roughness.jpg.raw under assets/ (Phase 242) |
| scale | decimal | Metres of ground one texture tile covers (Phase 242) |
| biomes | json | Biomes whose flat ground this material covers (Phase 242) |
| slopeMin | decimal | Degrees from flat above which ground is this material whatever the biome; -1 = never (Phase 242) |
| aboveSnowLine | boolean | Whether this material covers ground above the biome's snowLine (Phase 242) |
| nearWater | decimal | Metres from open water within which this material covers wet ground; -1 = never (Phase 242) |
